thread:
Maria: Quick morning sync — microlaunch next Tues. Need final copy for Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing blurbs + 3 launch posts. Who can own the copy sweep?
Sam: I can take Hosted + social posts. Will align tone with hero and make 2 variants for A/B.
Jess: I'll own Dedicated + Private pages, focus the language on predictability (Dedicated) and compliance/controls (Private).
Liam: I'll review the dev docs and make sure CTAs map to the right demo/sign-up flows. Can we standardize form fields?
Olivia: Sales ops wants Dedicated/Private leads flagged as enterprise. Can we add a hidden field and routing rule?
Maria: Webinar gating question — two CTAs: 'Reserve your seat' for webinar, and 'Get benchmark brief' for immediate download. For pages: Hosted -> Try now; Dedicated -> Contact sales; Private -> Request trial & NDA. Agree?
Sam: Agree on CTAs. For Hosted hero I'm testing 'pay-as-you-go' vs 'on-demand' copy. Will run quick heatmap once live.
Jess: Draft copy snippets below — rough, feel free to edit: 

Hosted blurb: "Ship LLM features fast — Redwood Hosted API for low-latency generations and pay-as-you-go pricing."
Dedicated blurb: "Predictable throughput with Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed performance."
Private blurb: "Private deployments (VPC or on-prem) with KMS, audit logs, and enterprise controls for regulated workloads."

Liam: Good structure. Minor nit: use 'Dedicated capacity' consistently (not 'Reserved GPU pools' alone). Also confirm CTA button text length for mobile.
Olivia: Routing: I'll add requirement for hidden field source=launch-micro and tag mapping: Dedicated/Private -> enterprise, Hosted -> product-leads. Sales Ops needs the mapping by Friday.
Sam: I'll drop the form snippet in #devex once I finish the Hosted copy. Example snippet: 

```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"source\" value=\"launch-micro\">
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_tier\" value=\"product-lead\">
```

Jess: Webinar narrative: 20-min benchmark demo (latency + cost per request), 20-min product walkthrough (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), 10-min Q&A. Promo posts: 3 short posts — benchmark highlight, invite to webinar, gated brief.
Maria: Nice. Liam — can you export the latest benchmark PDF? We want a 1-pager: median latency, cost delta with batching, and quantization note.
Liam: Yup. I'll export the 1-pager and add a short summary line: "2s median latency on 8k context, 3x cost reduction via batching". Link will be posted here by Thu morning.
Olivia: Ops question — what happens to demo requests from Private? Sales wants an NDA step before scheduling. We'll route to SDR with tag 'needs-nda'.
Sam: Noted. I'll add a conditional to the form: if package=private then show NDA checkbox + set lead_tier=enterprise and needs_nda=true.
Maria: Action items summary:
- Sam: finalize Hosted copy + form snippets, post in #devex (due EOD Thu)
- Jess: finalize Dedicated & Private page copy + SLA phrasing (due Fri)
- Liam: export benchmark PDF + drop link (due Thu)
- Olivia: confirm routing & update playbook with Sales Ops (due Fri)

Maria: Quick style rules: use 'Hosted API' (capitalized) in all places, prefer 'Dedicated capacity' phrase, and in Private copy emphasize 'audit logs' and 'KMS integration'. Keep hero lines under 10 words if possible.
Sam: Got it :thumbsup:
LaunchBot: Reminder: create webinar landing page draft in Figma by Thursday 10:00 AM.
Maria: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after copy drop to review hero variants and social snippets.
